source.title: Pain networks from the inside: Spatiotemporal analysis of brain responses leading from nociception to conscious perception.

confidence_rationale: Direct human intracranial-EEG evidence that nociceptive input reaches sensory and limbic cortex in parallel via anatomically distinct ascending routes (spino-thalamic + spino-parabrachial), supporting a harm stream routed separately from exteroceptive processing. Strong source (iEEG in humans, the exact paper cited in the claim). Confidence held below source_quality because the paper is about adult cortical dynamics, not the developmental-differentiation-bounds-quality mechanism INV-089 actually asserts -- it grounds the separateness premise, not the maturation-order conclusion.
failure_signatures: The paper characterizes the temporal dynamics of an already-mature adult nociceptive network; it provides no developmental time-course, so it cannot by itself establish that z_harm differentiation matures on a schedule distinct from z_world's -- only that the two streams are anatomically separable in the adult.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Nociceptive inputs reach sensory and limbic networks simultaneously through parallel spino-thalamic and spino-parabrachial pathways, with operculo-insular and mid-cingulate cortices activated as an initial pre-conscious stage distinct from the fronto-parietal exteroceptive network.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports the SD-010 architectural choice underpinning INV-089: harm is carried by its own encoder (HarmEncoder -> z_harm), anatomically parallel to and separable from the z_world exteroceptive encoder, rather than being a downstream read-off of the world representation.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The biological separateness is a parallel ANATOMICAL/functional routing in adults; INV-089's load-bearing content is a DEVELOPMENTAL claim (z_harm has its own differentiation trajectory that bounds harm-evaluator quality). This paper evidences the routing premise, not the maturation-ordering conclusion -- transfer to the developmental claim is an inference, not a measurement.
mapping.source_context: Human intracranial (depth-electrode) EEG in 12 epilepsy patients; nociceptive-specific laser pulses; first 1 s post-stimulus.

confidence_components.notes: iEEG in humans is high-quality and directly on-target for the stream-separation premise; transfer_risk is moderate because the claim's real payload is developmental and this is adult data.
